index.title: Assign Team Members to Tasks
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Team Members. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Assign Team Members to Tasks. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job,
index.what_happened_excerpt: A team member used a chat platform or web service to match users with the correct team member based on task requirements. This job is the public pattern.
